 Bench At Aurangabad

 (Vishnu Madhukarrao Mundhe Vs. The State of Maharashtra and

Mr.R.D.Biradar, Advocate for the petitioner.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature Of Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr.S.R.Yadav, Agp for respondent Nos. 1 and 2.
( Coram : Ravindra V.Ghuge, J.)
The petitioner is before this Court being aggrieved by the order of the District Consumer Redressal Forum, Latur dated 06/03/2018 by which, he was directed to deposit an amount of Rs.1,05,000/-.

The petitioner preferred a Revision Petition No.6/2018 before the State Dispute Redressal Commission, Aurangabad, which was rejected by order dated 05/09/2018 on the ground that a revision cannot be entertained u/s 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. The petitioner has deposited the said amount of Rs.1,05,000/-
in this Court pursuant to the order of this Court dated 25/01/2019.
4.
In view of the above, this petition is disposed off.

The Registry is directed to expeditiously transmit the amount of Rs.1,05,000/-
alongwith accrued interest, if any, to the District Consumer Redressal Forum, Latur, which is ex-officio Appellate Tribunal under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
5. The petitioner shall appear before the concerned Forum at Latur on 15/07/2019.
The respondents shall also cause an appearance on the same date and formal notices need not be issued by the learned Forum.
